head: Legion Go Beam leak: Lenovo handheld may run Android
dek: Lenovo's unannounced Legion Go Beam looks to be an Android handheld with a 7-inch, 120Hz screen that streams games from a PC or console, according to material Windows Latest obtained. Lenovo hasn't announced it, and there's no price or date.
details: It would also run Android games on the device, plus cloud and retro games, likely on a Snapdragon G2 Gen 1 chip, which Windows Latest says could still change. The leak lists Wi-Fi 6E, Lenovo's Legion Space app, a microSD slot, a headphone jack, one USB-C port, built-in controls with two back buttons and no touchpad. Battery size and storage aren't known.
where: Not announced: details from a leak; no price or date
means: If you want a small device to play your PC or console games around the house, this may be one more choice. Nothing here is confirmed yet.
todo: Nothing to do yet; wait for Lenovo's announcement with the price and the date.
